(1) Select a latitude, time-of-day point that has the maximum bandwidth demand.
(2) Add an SS-plane that intersects that point and subtract the capacity of one satellite from all latitude, time-of-day points covered by the plane's path (clamping to zero).
(3) If all demand is satisfied, return the accumulated set of planes, otherwise go back to (1).
